Prayer for a Virtual Tree Planting in Israel, by Rabbi Eliyahu Yosef She'ar Yashuv Cohen (2012)

tei:bibl.tei:title: תְּפִילַּת הַנּוֹטֵעַ
Prayer for a Virtual Tree Planting in Israel, by Rabbi Eliyahu Yosef She'ar Yashuv Cohen (2012)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Eliyahu Yosef She'ar Yashuv Cohen
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: This is the prayer for planting trees by the late chief rabbi of Haifa, Eliyahu Yosef She’ar Yashuv Cohen zt”l (1927-2016). The text of the prayer here is adapted from the text provided in 2017 by the Union of Synagogues & Communities in Israel (איחוד בתי הכנסת והקהילות בישראל). We are uncertain whether the prayer may have been written prior to 2012 for “virtual” tree plantings sponsored by the JNF (קק״ל), ostensibly so that Diaspora Jewish communities could take part in tree planting ceremonies in Erets Yisrael. As far as we are aware, this is the first time the prayer has been translated into English.
